business_problem: Jefferson Health needed to move its on-premises Epic environment to the cloud to improve resiliency, disaster recovery, security, and the agility to support future growth and innovation.
solution_summary: Jefferson Health is migrating its Epic electronic health record environment and surrounding ecosystem to Azure so clinicians, researchers, and operations teams can work from a more resilient and scalable platform. The healthcare network had already placed its data warehouse on Azure, and the Epic migration extends that cloud strategy into a core clinical system where business continuity, security hardening, and elastic scale matter directly to patient care. Key components include Epic electronic health record remains the system of record for patient and clinical workflows during the migration; Azure provides the purpose-built cloud reference architecture, resiliency, and security baseline for the Epic deployment. Jefferson expects stronger resiliency, disaster recovery, business continuity, contemporary security controls, and a more agile path for onboarding remaining facilities and future digital innovation.
